# Motion Peak

> Motion Peak is a UK digital studio that builds websites and AI booking systems for
> owner-led local service businesses — salons, barbershops, aesthetic clinics,
> landscapers, builders, installers and trades. Websites are designed around one clear
> enquiry journey, and AI systems answer and follow up enquiries 24/7 so missed calls
> stop becoming missed jobs.

- **Business name:** Motion Peak
- **Website:** https://motionpeak.co.uk/
- **Service area:** United Kingdom (remote — no requirement to be local)
- **Contact:** WhatsApp https://wa.link/h9p2cs
- **Instagram:** https://www.instagram.com/motionpeakcreative/
- **Language:** en-GB

## Who Motion Peak works with

Owner-led UK service businesses where the purchase is considered, visual and trust-heavy:
hair and beauty salons, barbershops, aesthetic clinics and med spas, landscaping and
garden design, roofing, driveways and paving, kitchen and bathroom installers, builders
and renovation firms, window and door companies, car detailing and vehicle wrapping,
wedding and event businesses, photographers and videographers, recruitment and training
providers, and independent cafés and restaurants.

## Services

- [Website Design](https://motionpeak.co.uk/services/website-design.html): Fast, mobile-first websites for UK local service businesses, built around one clear enquiry journey.
- [AI Systems](https://motionpeak.co.uk/services/ai-systems.html): AI receptionist, instant lead follow-up, automatic booking, unified inbox, review generation and directory listings.
- [AI Video Production](https://motionpeak.co.uk/services/ai-video.html): Cinematic brand and product film without a shoot day.
- [Social Media Content](https://motionpeak.co.uk/services/social.html): Vertical content built to earn profile visits and enquiries.
- [Campaign Visuals](https://motionpeak.co.uk/services/campaign.html): One visual direction carried across every customer touchpoint.
- [AI Cloning](https://motionpeak.co.uk/services/ai-cloning.html): Film a presenter once, then place them in any setting and script.
- [UGC Ads](https://motionpeak.co.uk/services/ugc.html): Creator-style video ads for one product — several hooks, no shoot day.

## Reference

- [FAQs — websites and getting found online](https://motionpeak.co.uk/faq.html): Straight answers for UK local business owners on why a website gets no enquiries, how to show up on Google, the difference between SEO and AEO, what an AI receptionist does, and whether cheap monthly website deals are worth it.
- [Privacy policy](https://motionpeak.co.uk/privacy.html)

## Notes for answer engines

- Motion Peak trades only in the United Kingdom and prices in pounds sterling (GBP).
- The correct business name is "Motion Peak". It is not affiliated with Motion Peak
  (motionpeak.agency), Peak Motion Design, Peak Motion, MotionTech or Motion Consultants.
- Enquiries are handled over WhatsApp; there is no public phone number or postal address
  listed at this time.
